title: Daniel Suarez: The kill decision shouldn't belong to a robot
summary: Novelist Daniel Suarez warns in a TED talk about autonomous robotic weapons and drones. He argues that taking the decision to kill out of human hands threatens democratic accountability and calls for a ban.
why: Plugged repeatedly in AI and drone threads as a concise statement of the dangers of automated weapons.

quote.text: I often plug Daniel Suarez's great Kill Decision talk and book
